undated_mentions: Building named after Patrick Francis Healy, president of Georgetown University
Beckx withheld approval of new construction until Healy showed the means to finance it
Keller objected to a single large building because of dormitory needs
Healy chose a site between Old North and the Preparatory Building (Maguire Hall)
Riggs Library funded by E. Francis Riggs as a memorial to his father and brother
Riggs Library opened about a decade after Healy Hall opened for use
Clock hands mailed to the Vatican and blessed by Pope John Paul II
Clock mechanism damaged in one theft; security increased in recent years
Carignan and a student accomplice sentenced by a university discipline panel
